title: ECG Simulator
summary: Computational cardiac electrophysiology pipeline that connects cellular mechanisms to clinical ECG signals.
problem: How can we connect ion-channel and tissue-level conduction models to interpretable ECG waveforms?
architecture: Modular simulation pipeline: cell models → tissue conduction → body-surface potential → ECG synthesis.
designPhilosophy: Prefer mechanistic clarity over black-box accuracy; every waveform stage must be inspectable.
